playstyle: A four-fighter Order warband whose every fighter carries both melee and ranged weapons, giving unusual board-wide flexibility. Three fighters sport solid four-wound frames with single-shield saves, while the swift Sleek scouts ahead on Move 4 with a dodge save. The warband suits two distinct approaches: an aggressive push into enemy territory to seize treasures and inspire, or a defensive hold where home-half fighters can neither be flanked nor surrounded. Both styles rely on switching between melee and ranged to maintain pressure across the board.
